name: program-runtime.improve-cycle
purpose: Take the setpoint-read envelope as the board, pick the first out-of-band readable row in setpoint order, and route it to one improve-skill route label deterministically.

board.description: The envelope printed by program-runtime.setpoint-read: signals.rows in table order and signals.failure_shapes.

assumptions: the board was produced by program-runtime.setpoint-read in the same cycle
route labels are the rows of program-runtime-improve §5; the skill, not this program, says what each route does

rows setpoint-read declines by construction (discovery-floor, authoring-floor, attribution, external-friction, fleet-improve-coverage) are routed by the skill's §5 table from a shell reading or from the program named in the row's reason, never by this program
ai-gateway is reachable only when two failure shapes tie; otherwise no inference runs
invariants: no scenario binding is called; the only external call is ai.classify on a tie, in the classify phase
decide is a pure table lookup with no I/O
a declined row is never routed; declined rows are listed with their reason
the route for a given board is deterministic except on a declared tie
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path

bindings.note: reached only on a tie between two failure shapes

signals.row: the setpoint row routed this cycle, or null when every routable row is in band
signals.shape: the failure shape the route was keyed on: a shape name, duplicate, or *
signals.route: one route label: failure-w3-preflight-import, failure-w3-argv-quoting, failure-w2-closed-vocabulary, governance-curation-mine-unresolved, act-w1-or-blocked-note, condition-report-bug, delegation-w3-and-report-bug, library-set-current, library-curate, or in-band
signals.rationale: why this row and route: table match, top failure shape, or the tie the classifier broke
signals.declined: list of {row, reason} for rows the board declined, at most 12; the skill routes these from the reason

outputs.evidence: the routed row's reading and target, as text

rows.target: 0 candidates older than one cycle; 0 duplicate binding sets
